basis.terminal_count: Representative terminal groups for spatial attribution, not surveyed operating units.
basis.berths_and_cranes: Anchored to published Port of Los Angeles terminal and infrastructure facts; simplified for the optimizer.
basis.yard_capacity: Deterministic planning proxy informed by published terminal acreage/storage examples.
basis.staffing: Three eight-hour shifts; one supervisor role per task. No historical labor roster was available.
basis.weather_and_tide: Neutral required model inputs, explicitly calibrated because this AIS package contains neither source. Twelve pre-cutoff tide observations prevent the optimizer from using its conservative missing-tide fallback.
basis.carry_in_operations: Latest pre-cutoff berth-start per proxy berth reserves its berth and two home cranes. Remaining workload is calibrated from elapsed time and handling rate; no future departure observations are used.
basis.yard_policy: Uses the same default safe-yard and demand-derived productivity margins as the main optimizer, rather than assuming every yard is fully saturated for all 120 hours.
